name: Supabase publishable key
description: A Supabase opaque publishable key, sb_publishable_ followed by a 22-character random part, an underscore and an 8-character checksum, the same layout as the sb_secret_ key. Supabase documents it as safe to expose online (web page, app, CLI, source code); it only reaches what Row Level Security allows. The legacy JWT-shaped anon key is not covered here.

sources.supports: Key types: sb_publishable_ keys are 'Safe to expose online: web page, mobile or desktop app, GitHub actions, CLIs, source code.'
